subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw expose all five memory roles now, or initially expose only roles with complete agent-aware invocation protocols?
rationale: Automation can identify the missing capture and user-model routing, but only maintainers can decide whether foundation-only public keys are an acceptable durable plugin and configuration contract.

options.title: Require complete protocols
options.body: Add agent-aware capture and user-model invocation seams before exposing the complete five-role contract.

options.title: Narrow initial contract
options.body: Remove capture and userModel from this PR and introduce them later with focused runtime protocols.

options.title: Accept foundation keys
options.body: Publish all five selectors now and explicitly own that capture and userModel are activation markers until later protocol work.

recommendation.title: Require complete protocols
recommendation.body: Add agent-aware capture and user-model invocation seams before exposing the complete five-role contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice establishes durable cross-cutting product, configuration, and plugin API semantics.
